messages:
ashley: Quick thought — can we do a retrofitted compatibility shim that signals v1 clients via header instead of routing by model tag? trying to avoid explicit v1 routes in console.
ben: You mean `X-Redwood-Compat: v1` header and let router map to v1-compatible variants? sounds good but quota implications.
maya: TL;DR: header-based routing easier for rollout, harder for quota accounting. We'd need quota attenuation mapping.
samir: For SLA/ops, any shim that hides version will make incident triage harder. Need telemetry tags: compat.version, shim=true, original_route.
ashley: Agree on telemetry. Console needs to surface a "compat shim traffic" breakdown per customer.
ben: Implementation sketch:
```
if req.headers['X-Redwood-Compat']=='v1':
  route = runtime.find_compatible_variant(req.model, 'v1')
  tag = 'compat:v1'
```
But how do we handle quota? bill on target model or original api? both have consequences.
maya: Proposal: bill at original API bucket but record token cost at target model for cost analytics. So cost-metric = target_model_tokens, quota-usage = api_bucket_tokens.
samir: That's reasonable. Add a console affordance to show 'estimated model cost' vs 'quota charged'.
ashley: Also need a rollback path. If target model isn't available, fallback to degraded mode (shorter seq len) not silent fail.
ben: We'll need a rollout plan: 1) internal canary (5%), 2) opt-in beta orgs, 3) 25% probe with telemetry guards, 4) full flip. Telemetry guard rules: >3% error delta or >15% cost delta triggers auto-rollback.
maya: UX asks: show a per-customer toggle (console) to opt out of shim, and an org-level override. Also surface a migration checklist with test prompts.
reliability: Ops note: ensure incident playbook maps compat tags to runbooks. infra-bot will tag incidents with compat when present.
infra-bot: Deploy started to staging: `shim-retrofit-v1` rollout job queued.
ashley: Next steps: PR for router + quota mapper + telemetry tags. @ben can you draft the console mock for the affordances? @maya can you enumerate billing edge cases?
ben: On it, mock by EOD.
maya: I'll collect edge cases and send a short doc.
